_comment: Upcoming election events rendered on the Overview tab. Maintained by the weekly Cowork routine — the candidate-matchup verifier should confirm dates and add/remove events as primaries resolve. Past events are auto-hidden by the UI (kept here for the record). kind: primary | runoff | special | convention | general.

events.title: Georgia GOP gubernatorial runoff
events.note: Resolved: Rick Jackson defeated Burt Jones 52.9-47.1; faces Keisha Lance Bottoms Nov 3. Same night, Rep. Mike Collins beat Derek Dooley ~55-45 in the GOP Senate runoff and faces Sen. Jon Ossoff.

events.title: Arizona primaries
events.note: Resolved: Andy Biggs won the GOP nomination (~70% to Schweikert's 17%); faces Hobbs Nov 3.

events.title: Maine Democratic convention
events.note: Resolved: Troy Jackson nominated 566-5 over Sandra Pelletier (571 delegates voting); faces Collins Nov 3.

events.title: GA-13 special election
events.note: Resolved: no majority. Marcye Scott 46.8%, Everton Blair Jr. 36.7% advance to the Aug 25 runoff; seat stays vacant.

events.title: Michigan primaries
events.note: Resolved: Abdul El-Sayed won the D Senate primary over Rep. Haley Stevens (~1 pt, AP-called Aug 5); faces Mike Rogers (R, unopposed) Nov 3. Governor: Jocelyn Benson won the D nod (~84% over Chris Swanson) and Rep. John James (R, Trump-endorsed) won the GOP nod over Perry Johnson. In MI-13, state Rep. Donavan McKinney defeated incumbent Rep. Shri Thanedar in the D primary (~52-48).

events.title: Kansas primaries
events.note: Resolved (Senate): Sen. Roger Marshall (R) won renomination ~79%; Democrats nominated Rev. Adam Hamilton, a United Methodist pastor, over Christy Davis (~14%). Open-governor primaries were also held the same day (Ty Masterson was the Trump-endorsed R front-runner; Ethan Corson was Kelly-endorsed on the D side).

events.title: Wisconsin primaries
events.note: Resolved: David Crowley (Milwaukee County Executive, Evers-endorsed) won the Democratic primary in a photo finish over democratic socialist state Rep. Francesca Hong (~39.8-39.4%); faces Trump-backed Rep. Tom Tiffany Nov 3. Sabato moved the open race Toss-up->Leans D on Aug 13.

events.title: Minnesota primaries
events.note: Resolved: DFL Senate - Lt. Gov. Peggy Flanagan won ~59-40 over Rep. Angie Craig; faces Republican Michele Tafoya (won the GOP primary over Adam Schwarze and Royce White). Governor - Sen. Amy Klobuchar took the DFL nod ~90%; House Speaker Lisa Demuth won the GOP nod, setting a historic all-women general election. Both seats general Nov 3.

events.title: SC Senate special GOP primary
events.note: Resolved: no majority. Appointed Sen. Darline Graham Nordone and Rep. Ralph Norman advanced to the Aug 25 runoff (Rep. Russell Fry finished third and was eliminated); nominee faces Annie Andrews (D) Nov 3. Norman and Fry keep their House seats - no vacancy.

events.title: Alaska top-4 primary
events.note: Top four advance to ranked-choice general. 16 Senate candidates on the ballot; only Sullivan (R) and Peltola (D) have raised money. A second 'Dan Sullivan' was allowed on the ballot by the Alaska Supreme Court and is under federal/state investigation.

events.title: Florida primaries
events.note: Resolved: state Rep. Angie Nixon (progressive) upset Alex Vindman in the Democratic Senate-special primary despite being outspent ~$16M to <$1M; Nixon faces appointed Sen. Ashley Moody (R) on Nov 3. Moody won the nominal GOP primary the same day.

events.title: CA-14 special runoff
events.note: Formally a special runoff under the Apr 14 proclamation: Aisha Wahab vs. Melissa Hernandez, both D. Filling Swalwell's seat.

events.title: GA-13 special runoff
events.note: Held Aug 25 (result pending final count as of this run). Marcye Scott vs. Everton Blair Jr., both Democrats — safe-D seat, so the winner is a Democrat either way. Winner serves the remainder of the late David Scott's term and is not immediately sworn in, so the House vacancy count is unchanged for now.

events.title: SC Senate special GOP primary runoff
events.note: Held Aug 25 (result pending final count as of this run): appointed Sen. Darline Graham Nordone (R) vs. Rep. Ralph Norman (R). Nominee faces Annie Andrews (D) on Nov 3. Neither Norman nor Fry vacated a US House seat, so no House vacancy results.

events.title: New Hampshire primaries
events.note: Last primary of the cycle: former Sen. John E. Sununu (Trump-endorsed, led Brown 48-25 in UNH polling) vs. Scott Brown for the R Senate nod. Chris Pappas is the heavy D favorite.

events.title: General Election Day
events.note: 35 Senate seats, all 435 House seats, 36 governorships.

events.title: Georgia Senate runoff (if needed)
events.note: Only if no candidate clears 50% on Nov 3. Matchup is Sen. Jon Ossoff (D) vs. Rep. Mike Collins (R).
